segment_contamination_dimensions: Generic non-healthcare prefabricated structures (industrial sheds, warehouses, labour colonies, schools) — buyers of those structures are not healthcare infrastructure buyers and their vocabulary must not contaminate this MCAT's names
Prefabricated Isolation Ward (sibling MCAT 444552) — a single-ward modular unit is a sub-component, not a complete hospital; names must not be scoped down to isolation ward only

Temporary or portable-only framing — while portable hospitals are a valid product type, names must not reduce the MCAT to temporary-only structures, as the primary segment includes permanent turnkey hospital buildings
